items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Well they were going to have rehearsal at my house and Sy Kye Collins, this boy that had played with Troy, had cut out from Troy's band and came over to Boots' band

ctx.x: Okay. Well that's the record, I mean that is the part.

Well that's the record that made Boots and that's the record of course that made me and myself at the same time made Boots. We had no idea that was going to be a hit. I'll tell you how that came about. We had some music there with this tune Cherry, they called it Cherry but it was written so doggone high it was still up around C and above all the time. Really we couldn't play it. Didn't have anybody in the band could reach those high notes except the third man and he couldn't have the first. And I could make, I…
up with me, he liked to hang around my house all the time.
